extraction.name: SCIENCE QA
extraction.description: A multimodal multiple-choice science question dataset containing 21,208 examples with lectures and explanations.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.publisher: Allen Institute for AI, University of California, Los Angeles, Arizona State University
extraction.citeAs: Leam to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions in the SCIENCE QA dataset are sourced from open resources managed by IXL Learning, an online learning platform curated by experts in the field of K-12 education.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset includes problems that align with California Common Core Content Standards.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Questions without multiple correct answers were processed to have only one correct answer. Answer options were shuffled to ensure no specific pattern.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions for easier use.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Lectures and explanations were annotated to reveal the reasoning path to the correct answer.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The collected data does not contain personally identifiable information or offensive content.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The proposed dataset and designed methods are beneficial to both follow-up research work and real-world applications, particularly in K-12 education.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset provides a useful benchmark for multi-modal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence.
